parts.text: Fix the shovel only. His raised empty fist in front of his chest must firmly grip the wooden handle of the rusty shovel, knuckles to the viewer, with the shovel resting on that same shoulder and its blade up behind that shoulder. The shovel must not float behind his head and its handle must not cross behind his neck to the other side. Keep the spear in his other hand exactly as is. Keep everything else identical: burlap hood, coveralls, backpack, green clay backdrop, blood splats, pose, clay style. No text.
